---
title: "check-faq-resolution skill"
format: gfm
---

Step 3 of the AI-assisted IT ticketing workflow: decide whether the FAQ knowledge base can resolve a triaged ticket.

This version is deliberately easy to explain to MBA students. It does not score
FAQ rows with custom rules. Instead, it gives the LLM the ticket, the triage
decision, and the active FAQ table, then asks for a structured JSON decision.

## Layout

```text
skills/check-faq-resolution/
├── SKILL.md
├── README.qmd
└── scripts/
    └── check_faq_resolution.py
```

## Install

The single repo-root `install.sh` registers every skill at once (auto-discovers
any folder under `skills/` that has a `SKILL.md`):

```bash
bash install.sh
```

## Usage through Claude

> "Can we close TKT-00042 with the FAQ KB or do we need to escalate?"

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, runs the script, and reports the verdict plus the recommended next step.

## Direct CLI

```bash
uv run python skills/check-faq-resolution/scripts/check_faq_resolution.py --ticket-id TKT-00042
```

The script expects `TRITONAI_API_KEY` in `.env`, `~/.env`, or the shell. It
calls the model through `utils.connect.ask_json()`, the same helper used by the
course examples. Use `--model` to override the default model.

The script writes `data/working/faq_decisions.csv` and appends to `data/working/ticket_action_log.csv`.

## Public functions

- `load_faq_context(data_dir, out_dir, ticket_id)` — loads ticket, active FAQs, and the latest triage decision. Live mode requires working triage; demo mode can use processed fallback.
- `build_llm_prompt(context)` — JSON prompt containing ticket, triage, and active FAQs.
- `call_llm_for_faq_decision(context, model)` — calls the LLM and parses its JSON response.
- `normalize_llm_decision(raw, valid_faq_ids)` — validates the model response and derives the next step.
- `build_faq_decision_row(context, model)` — end-to-end row for `faq_decisions.csv`.
- `write_faq_decision(out_dir, decision)` — appends to `data/working/faq_decisions.csv`.
- `main(argv)` — CLI entrypoint. Exit codes: 0 ok, 2 missing ticket / data, 3 missing upstream triage, 4 LLM decision failed.

## Algorithm

1. Load the submitted ticket.
2. Load the upstream triage decision.
3. Load every active FAQ.
4. Ask the LLM to choose the one FAQ that directly resolves the ticket, or to choose no match.
5. Validate the JSON response.
6. Draft from the FAQ only when the model found a direct match, the confidence is at least `0.70`, and the required customer information is present.
7. Otherwise, escalate to a specialist.

The decision row records: `faq_match_found`, `faq_id`, `match_confidence`,
`search_terms` (`llm_full_faq_review`), `candidate_faq_ids` (all active FAQ ids
reviewed), `required_customer_info_available`, and a human-readable
`faq_application_reason`.

See `IMPROVEMENT_IDEAS.md` for ways to harden this simple version after
students understand the core skill.

## Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_check_faq_resolution.py -v
```
